paragraphs.text: The Anvilonian Grimoire is an artifact of the ages and a treasure to any mage. It supposedly contains every enchantment and mystic pronouncement known in Dominaria , although its passages are so convoluted that even skimming it can exceed the limits of one's sanity. Despite this, it does not mention the Prophecy of None, One, and Two . Johan is the only mage known to possess a copy of the grimoire.
The coming of Adun Oakenshield is foreseen in this book.
